Motorists who have not yet started their journeys have been advised to use an alternative route through Iten, Eldoret, Eldama Ravine and Kabarnet.

data.raw_text: The Kenya National Highways Authority (KeNHA) has announced the closure of a section of the Iten–Kabarnet Road after a landslide caused by heavy rainfall blocked the route. In a traffic advisory issued on May 2, the incident occurred near Kolol, making the affected stretch impassable. #starkenyanews
